accounts.name: Narrative architect — the story that organises the market, the incentives holding it together, and the fact that changes its meaning

queue.body:
Jobless claims are averaging 202k a week this month, 11.1% below a year ago.
GDPNow has the economy growing at a 5.1% annual rate this quarter.
The labor market is still tightening while the economy accelerates. That combination has historically kept the Fed on hold.
Five green weeks into the most-traded price at 177. $GATX
$CLH is 323 to hold, 405 the first target. Fourth test of the high since July, three prior holds.
